title: InstantSearch props are not all updated when they change
body:
**Current behavior**

 the only props that are updated if changed on the `InstantSearch` component are `searchState`, `onSearchStateChange` and `createUrl`.

All the others: `appId`, `apiKey`, `indexName` and `searchParameters` can't be changed once the InstantSearch is mounted. 

This behavior is not natural as you expect changes in props to have repercussion on InstantSearch.

**Expected Behavior**

Props are updated accordingly in new ones are provided.

comments.body:
